ing data originates from ScanNet’s 1,201 distinct scenes.                        batch size 2, freezing detector parameters. Implemented in

6. Qualitative Analysis                                                 three experiments.

Qualitative comparisons reveal CAC(O&H)’s significant
descriptive improvements over Vote2Cap-DETR++ in accu-                  yielding significantly faster convergence than Oblique-only
rately capturing object attributes and spatial relationships,           optimization.
as shown in Figure 4. Where Vote2Cap++ misidentifies a
black trash can as a “blue recycling bin” and mislabels a               7. Conclusion
dispenser as a “fire extinguisher”, CAC correctly identifies
these as a “black trash can” and “rectangular dispenser” re-            We introduce the CAC framework, which resolves the
spectively. More crucially, CAC demonstrates superior spa-              localization-contextualization conflict in 3D scene un-
tial awareness, describing furniture arrangements with pre-             derstanding by unifying Oblique-space geodesic atten-
cise references like “it is the second chair from the right”            tion—enforcing column-wise unit-norm constraints for
and contextualizing relationships as “the table is surrounded           isotropic stability—and Lorentzian hyperbolic attention
by chairs”, while Vote2Cap++ generates implausible state-               (κH = −c) for hierarchical semantics. This geometric
ments such as “the table is to the left of the table” and               synergy prevents dimensional collapse and ensures robust
vague descriptions like “it is to the left of the room”. As             feature learning. State-of-the-art results on ScanRefer and
evidenced in Figure 5, our approach achieves earlier con-               Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate significant gains in localiza-
vergence to optimal solutions compared to Vote2Cap++,                   tion accuracy and descriptive richness, laying a solid foun-
with dual-space learning in both Oblique and Lorentz Space              dation for embodied AI applications.
